intro: Treshala Fallowbrook is a night elf residing quietly on the upper level of the Tradesmen's Terrace in Darnassus. She is the wife of Heralath Fallowbrook, whose work has taken him far from home into the thorny depths of Razorfen Kraul in the Barrens.

p: Treshala Fallowbrook keeps a modest vigil on the second floor of a workshop in Darnassus's Tradesmen's Terrace. Her husband, Heralath, journeyed to the brambled depths of Razorfen Kraul in the Barrens, and she waits at home for word of him. The two are joined by a pendant of bonding, a keepsake of their marriage that Heralath carried with him into the quilboar's warrens.
